verdict.rationale: Circle offers indirect paths to natural-language operation. Its official MCP server lets an LLM or AI-assisted IDE work with Circle's offerings, but the docs frame it as generating and fixing code rather than executing operations. The Agent Stack CLI and Agent Wallets let AI agents hold funds, transfer, swap and bridge USDC autonomously through a single command interface, so an LLM agent could drive the product, but nothing documents first-party natural-language command handling. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language interface or MCP tools that execute live operations (not just code generation), examples of prompt-driven operation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
